Name: (CP) Ghostly Gunther
Author: SchrodingersKit
Description:
[font=Tahoma][size=4]Updated for 1.6![/size]

After reading[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/FanTheories/comments/5oevf9/stardew_valley_gunther_the_librarian_is_a_ghost/] this fan theory about Gunther potentially being a ghost[/url], I wanted to make 'ghostly' sprites to match~ One shares Grandpa's bright blues, and one shares the grayish green colors of the Ghost in the mines. Choose whichever version you prefer!
Graphical mod only, no additional storyline event at this time.
[b][size=3]
SVE compatible version is under Optional Files-- please read instructions carefully and be sure to back up your original Gunther PNG files before install![/size][/b]



[size=2][b]To install Content Patcher version--[/b][/size]
1. Install the latest versions of [url=https://canimod.com/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
2. Unzip and paste into your 'Mods' folder.
3. After first run, go into the generated config.json (can be opened using [url=https://notepad-plus-plus.org/]Notepad++[/url] or program of your choice) to choose your desired color (default is Blue). Alternatively, use [url=http://https//www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to make your choice in-game.﻿
4. Load up your game and enjoy!


[/font][font=Tahoma][b]To install SVE alt version (under optional files)--
[/b][/font][font=Tahoma][b]1. Backup your original SVE files!
[/b][/font][font=Tahoma]2. Unzip the file with your program of choice
[/font][font=Tahoma]3. Choose your preferred color, Blue or Green, and open that folder
[/font][font=Tahoma]4. Copy and paste each PNG file into their corresponding folder [/font][font=Tahoma](assets > CharacterFiles > OverworldSprites > Gunther)[/font][font=Tahoma](assets > CharacterFiles > Portraits > Gunther)
[/font][font=Tahoma]5. Load up your game and enjoy![/font]

Downloads.Description: Requires Stardew Valley Expanded/SVE. ZIP includes PNGs and Read Me for instructions on installation.
Choose the color of Gunther Ghost you want with the config.json, generated on the first run after install. Works in Stardew 1.6. Requires the latest versions of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
